excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上的考古探险队发来报告，由于一系列未曾预料的设备故障，工程出现了延期。在拿到替代设备之前，考察工作将暂时停滞。
excerpt.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has reported delays caused by an unlikely series of equipment malfunctions. Work has been halted momentarily until replacements can be acquired.
